mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 5% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both PAYEMS increases and FEDFUNDS rises, it indicates a tightening labor market and potential monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS increase but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher FEDFUNDS leads to increased borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases during tightening.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation as indicated by CPIAUCSL leads to potential rate hikes, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is high but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 115) signals supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops below 115 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) increase, it indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS increase but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong payroll growth (PAYEMS) may lead to inflation concerns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS grows strongly but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle cases.
